Patient guide · Interactive tools
a complete guide

strings.zh: 臨床量表(scoring tools)是皮膚科醫師客觀量化嚴重度、追蹤治療反應、判斷生物製劑健保資格的關鍵工具。本指南整理 10 大常用量表的適用對象、評估方法、分數解讀、結果對應治療策略、限制與原始引用，讓您看懂自己的病情並與醫師有效溝通。
strings.en: Clinical scoring tools are how dermatologists quantify severity objectively, track response to treatment, and judge eligibility for NHI-funded biologics. This guide covers the intended patient, method, how to read the score, the treatment strategy it points to, the limitations and the original citation for the ten scales used most, so you can understand your own disease and discuss it precisely with your doctor.

strings.zh: 重要提醒：本指南所有量表為「病人自評輔助工具」，不取代專科醫師面對面評估。生物製劑健保申請、處方治療決策需由皮膚專科醫師依完整病史與檢查決定。本網站無業配、無贊助，所有引用學會共識可點擊 PubMed 查證。
strings.en: Important: every scale here is a patient self-assessment aid and does not replace a face-to-face specialist assessment. NHI biologic applications and prescribing decisions must be made by a dermatologist on the full history and examination. This site carries no advertising and no sponsorship; every society consensus cited can be checked on PubMed.
10 scales · quick jump
1 · SCORAD (atopic dermatitis)
2 · PASI (psoriasis)
3 · DLQI (quality of life)
4 · SALT (alopecia areata)
5 · UAS7 (urticaria)
6 · GAGS (acne)
7 · MASI (melasma)
8 · Hurley (hidradenitis suppurativa)
9 · Norwood-Ludwig (androgenetic alopecia)
10 · Fitzpatrick (skin phototype)
Score 0-103
Atopic dermatitis
Who it is for

strings.zh: 所有年齡層異位性皮膚炎(AD)：嬰幼兒、兒童、成人皆可
strings.en: Atopic dermatitis (AD) at any age: infants, children and adults alike

strings.zh: 追蹤治療前後反應（用藥前 / 4 週 / 12 週對照）
strings.en: Tracking response before and after treatment (baseline / 4 weeks / 12 weeks)

strings.zh: 判定 Dupilumab、JAK 抑制劑、Tralokinumab、Lebrikizumab 等生物製劑申請參考
strings.en: A reference point when applying for biologics such as dupilumab, JAK inhibitors, tralokinumab or lebrikizumab

strings.zh: 評估方式 — 三大組件
strings.en: Method — three components

strings.zh:
A · 受影響面積(0-100%)：依「九分法」估算
  • 頭頸部 9% / 上肢各 9%（雙側 18%)/ 軀幹前 18% / 軀幹後 18% / 下肢各 18%（雙側 36%)/ 會陰 1%
  • 嬰幼兒比例不同：頭部 18%、下肢各 13.5%
strings.en:
A · Affected area (0-100%), estimated by the rule of nines
  • Head and neck 9% / each upper limb 9% (18% both) / front of trunk 18% / back of trunk 18% / each lower limb 18% (36% both) / perineum 1%
  • Infants differ: head 18%, each lower limb 13.5%

strings.zh:
B · 6 項客觀症狀總分(0-18，每項 0-3)
  • 紅斑(Erythema)、水腫 / 丘疹(Edema/Papulation)、滲出 / 結痂(Oozing/Crust)、抓痕(Excoriation)、苔癬化(Lichenification)、乾燥(Dryness — 評估「未影響」區域）
  • 0 = 無 / 1 = 輕 / 2 = 中 / 3 = 重
strings.en:
B · Six objective signs, total 0-18 (each 0-3)
  • Erythema, oedema/papulation, oozing/crust, excoriation, lichenification, dryness (assessed on unaffected skin)
  • 0 = none / 1 = mild / 2 = moderate / 3 = severe

strings.zh:
C · 主觀症狀總分(0-20)
  • 癢感(Pruritus)0-10 + 失眠(Sleep loss)0-10
  • 取過去 3 天平均，病人自評
strings.en:
C · Subjective symptoms, total 0-20
  • Pruritus 0-10 + sleep loss 0-10
  • The average over the past 3 days, rated by the patient
How to read the score
Score
Severity
Treatment strategy it points to
Mild

strings.zh: 外用類固醇 + 保濕 + Tacrolimus / Pimecrolimus
strings.en: Topical corticosteroid + emollient + tacrolimus / pimecrolimus
Moderate

strings.zh: + NB-UVB 光療、Proactive therapy（週末預防擦藥）
strings.en: + NB-UVB phototherapy, proactive therapy (weekend maintenance application)
Severe

strings.zh: + Dupilumab / JAK 抑制劑 / Cyclosporine（短期）
strings.en: + Dupilumab / JAK inhibitor / ciclosporin (short course)

strings.zh: 結果意義 + 下一步建議
strings.en: What the result means, and what to do next

strings.zh: SCORAD ≥ 50 是台灣健保 Dupilumab 申請參考門檻之一（配合 EASI、DLQI、外用治療失敗）
strings.en: SCORAD ≥ 50 is one of the reference thresholds for a Taiwan NHI dupilumab application (alongside EASI, DLQI and failure of topical therapy)

strings.zh: 治療反應:SCORAD-50 = 治療後降幅 ≥ 50%（臨床顯著反應）;SCORAD-75 = 良好反應
strings.en: Response: SCORAD-50 = a fall of ≥ 50% after treatment (clinically meaningful); SCORAD-75 = a good response

strings.zh: 追蹤頻率：中重度建議每 4-12 週評估一次
strings.en: Follow-up: moderate-to-severe disease should be reassessed every 4-12 weeks

strings.zh: 嬰幼兒請參考 Werfel 2024 S3 兒童版調整（面積比例不同）
strings.en: For infants, adjust per the Werfel 2024 S3 paediatric version — the area proportions differ
Limitations and cautions

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 客觀症狀(B)需由皮膚科醫師評估，病人自評難以準確；(2) 受過去 3 天波動影響；(3) 未涵蓋手部、生殖器等特殊部位的功能性影響（可改用 EASI 或 POEM);(4) 嬰幼兒哭鬧時誤判紅斑。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) the objective signs (B) need a dermatologist's assessment and are hard for a patient to rate accurately; (2) it is sensitive to fluctuation over the past 3 days; (3) it does not capture the functional impact of hand or genital involvement (use EASI or POEM instead); (4) erythema is easily overcalled in a crying infant.
Original citation
Open the SCORAD calculator →
Score 0-72
Psoriasis

strings.zh: 斑塊型乾癬(plaque psoriasis)嚴重度評估
strings.en: Severity assessment for plaque psoriasis

strings.zh: 台灣健保生物製劑申請門檻:PASI ≥ 10 + BSA ≥ 10% + DLQI ≥ 10 + 兩線傳統治療(MTX / 光療 / Acitretin)失敗
strings.en: Taiwan NHI biologic threshold: PASI ≥ 10 + BSA ≥ 10% + DLQI ≥ 10, plus failure of two conventional therapies (methotrexate / phototherapy / acitretin)

strings.zh: 不適用：膿皰型、紅皮型、guttate（滴狀）、頭皮型（改用 PSSI)
strings.en: Not for: pustular, erythrodermic, guttate or scalp psoriasis (use PSSI for scalp)
Method

strings.zh:
PASI = 0.1×(Eh+Ih+Dh)×Ah + 0.2×(Ea+Ia+Da)×Aa + 0.3×(Et+It+Dt)×At + 0.4×(El+Il+Dl)×Al
h = 頭頸 / a = 上肢 / t = 軀幹 / l = 下肢
strings.en:
PASI = 0.1×(Eh+Ih+Dh)×Ah + 0.2×(Ea+Ia+Da)×Aa + 0.3×(Et+It+Dt)×At + 0.4×(El+Il+Dl)×Al
h = head and neck / a = upper limbs / t = trunk / l = lower limbs

strings.zh: 4 個身體區域權重：頭頸 ×0.1、上肢 ×0.2、軀幹 ×0.3、下肢 ×0.4（總和 = 1.0)
strings.en: Four body regions, weighted: head and neck ×0.1, upper limbs ×0.2, trunk ×0.3, lower limbs ×0.4 (summing to 1.0)

strings.zh:
每區評估 3 項症狀(0-4):
  • E · 紅斑(Erythema)：無 / 淡紅 / 中紅 / 深紅 / 暗紅
  • I · 浸潤(Infiltration)：厚度 — 無 / 薄 / 中 / 厚 / 極厚
  • D · 鱗屑(Desquamation)：無 / 細鱗 / 粗鱗 / 厚鱗 / 黏附
strings.en:
Three signs per region (0-4):
  • E · erythema: none / light red / red / dark red / deep red
  • I · induration (thickness): none / slight / moderate / thick / very thick
  • D · desquamation: none / fine / coarse / thick / adherent

strings.zh: 外用 Calcipotriol（達力士）/ Daivobet / 類固醇
strings.en: Topical calcipotriol / calcipotriol-betamethasone / corticosteroid

strings.zh: + NB-UVB / Acitretin / Methotrexate；準備生物製劑申請條件
strings.en: + NB-UVB / acitretin / methotrexate; start assembling the biologic application criteria
Moderate to severe

strings.zh: 達健保生物製劑門檻(IL-17 / IL-23 / Deucravacitinib)
strings.en: Meets the NHI biologic threshold (IL-17 / IL-23 / deucravacitinib)

strings.zh: Bimekizumab / Risankizumab / Guselkumab 三線最強；注意關節炎共病
strings.en: Bimekizumab, risankizumab and guselkumab are the strongest three; watch for coexisting arthritis
Response endpoints
PASI 75: a fall of ≥ 75% after treatment (the conventional target)

strings.zh: PASI 90：降幅 ≥ 90%(IL-23 級生物製劑常規目標）
strings.en: PASI 90: a fall of ≥ 90% (the routine target for IL-23-class biologics)
PASI 100: complete clearance (bimekizumab reaches over 60% at 16 weeks)

strings.zh: PASI ≥ 10 + BSA ≥ 10% + DLQI ≥ 10 + 雙線失敗 = 健保生物製劑可申請
strings.en: PASI ≥ 10 + BSA ≥ 10% + DLQI ≥ 10 + two failed conventional therapies = eligible to apply for an NHI biologic

strings.zh: 選擇生物製劑時考慮共病：乾癬性關節炎 → IL-17；發炎性腸道疾病 → IL-23 或 Deucravacitinib
strings.en: Choose the biologic around the comorbidity: psoriatic arthritis → IL-17; inflammatory bowel disease → IL-23 or deucravacitinib

strings.zh: 頭皮乾癬建議改用 PSSI(Psoriasis Scalp Severity Index)
strings.en: For scalp psoriasis use PSSI (Psoriasis Scalp Severity Index) instead

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 觀察者間差異大、需訓練；(2) 對輕度乾癬靈敏度低（分數變化 1-2 分但臨床改善明顯）;(3) 不適用膿皰型、紅皮型、皺褶型；(4) 局部嚴重（如手 / 臉）但 PASI 低 → 改用 BSA + DLQI 補充；(5) 深膚色紅斑判讀困難。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) inter-observer variation is wide and training is needed; (2) it is insensitive in mild psoriasis (a 1-2 point change can accompany obvious clinical improvement); (3) it does not apply to pustular, erythrodermic or inverse forms; (4) severe but localised disease (hands, face) can give a low PASI — supplement with BSA and DLQI; (5) erythema is harder to grade in darker skin.
Open the PASI calculator →
Score 0-30
Any skin disease

strings.zh: 16 歲以上所有慢性皮膚病（乾癬、異膚、蕁麻疹、結節性癢疹、HS、白斑等）
strings.en: Any chronic skin disease from age 16 — psoriasis, atopic dermatitis, urticaria, prurigo nodularis, HS, vitiligo and others

strings.zh: 生物製劑健保申請門檻：多數疾病 DLQI ≥ 10
strings.en: NHI biologic threshold: DLQI ≥ 10 for most conditions

strings.zh: 追蹤治療對生活品質的影響（不只是皮膚外觀）
strings.en: Tracking what treatment does to quality of life, not just to the appearance of the skin

strings.zh: 兒童版用 CDLQI(Children's DLQI,4-16 歲）、嬰幼兒用 IDQOL
strings.en: Children use CDLQI (Children's DLQI, ages 4-16); infants use IDQOL

strings.zh: 10 題自評、每題 0-3 分、總分 0-30。每題問「過去 1 週」皮膚問題對該面向的影響程度。
strings.en: Ten self-rated items, 0-3 each, total 0-30. Each asks how much your skin affected that aspect of life over the past week.
Item
Aspect
Itch, soreness, stinging (symptoms)
Embarrassment and self-consciousness (feelings)

strings.zh: 購物、家務、整理花園(日常活動)
strings.en: Shopping, housework, gardening (daily activities)
Choice of clothing (daily activities)
Social and leisure activities (leisure)
Sport (leisure)

strings.zh: 無法工作或念書(工作 / 學業)
strings.en: Prevented from working or studying (work / study)

strings.zh: 與伴侶 / 親友 / 家人關係(人際)
strings.en: Relationships with partner, friends and family (personal relationships)
Sexual difficulties (personal relationships)

strings.zh: 治療造成的困擾(治療負擔)
strings.en: Problems caused by the treatment itself (treatment burden)

strings.zh: 每題：0 完全沒有 / 1 一點點 / 2 中等 / 3 非常（若該題不適用 = 0)。
strings.en: Each item: 0 not at all / 1 a little / 2 a lot / 3 very much (score 0 if not relevant).
Impact
What it means
No effect
The skin problem is not affecting daily life
A small effect on daily life
A moderate effect on daily life

strings.zh: 達生物製劑健保申請門檻（配合疾病活動度）
strings.en: Meets the NHI biologic threshold (together with disease activity)
Extremely severe

strings.zh: 嚴重影響生活、建議生物製劑 + 心理共病評估
strings.en: Severely affecting life; consider a biologic plus assessment for psychological comorbidity

strings.zh: DLQI ≥ 10 在多數慢性皮膚病代表「非常大或極大的負面影響」
strings.en: DLQI ≥ 10 means a very large or extremely large negative effect in most chronic skin disease

strings.zh: 用於健保生物製劑申請時通常需要連續 2 次評估都 ≥ 10
strings.en: An NHI biologic application usually needs two consecutive assessments both ≥ 10

strings.zh: 注意題目「不適用」(N/A)計 0 分（例如：單身者 Q9 性生活不適用）— 可能造成低估
strings.en: Note that an item marked "not relevant" (N/A) scores 0 — for instance Q9 on sexual difficulties for someone single — which can understate the true impact

strings.zh: 分數突然下降但客觀疾病未改善 → 評估心理適應或忽略（精神共病可能掩蓋）
strings.en: A sudden fall in score without objective improvement → assess for psychological adaptation or avoidance; a psychiatric comorbidity can mask the picture

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 主觀、易受情緒、文化差異影響；(2) Q9 性生活在亞洲常被低估；(3) 兒童 / 老年人需替代版本；(4) 不能取代客觀疾病評估；(5) 單純對 DLQI ≥ 10 申請生物製劑、需配合疾病活動度量表(PASI、SCORAD、UAS7 等）。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) subjective, and sensitive to mood and cultural differences; (2) Q9 on sexual difficulties is commonly understated in Asia; (3) children and older people need the alternative versions; (4) it cannot replace objective disease assessment; (5) DLQI ≥ 10 alone does not support a biologic application — it must accompany a disease-activity scale (PASI, SCORAD, UAS7 and so on).
Open the DLQI calculator →
Score 0-100

strings.zh: 圓禿(Alopecia areata)頭皮禿髮面積評估
strings.en: Scalp hair-loss area in alopecia areata

strings.zh: 判定 JAK 抑制劑(Baricitinib、Ritlecitinib)適應症
strings.en: Establishing the indication for a JAK inhibitor (baricitinib, ritlecitinib)
Tracking response (SALT-50, SALT-30, SALT-20)

strings.zh: 不適用：雄性禿（用 Norwood-Ludwig)、瀰漫性落髮、瘢痕性禿髮
strings.en: Not for: androgenetic alopecia (use Norwood-Ludwig), diffuse telogen effluvium, or cicatricial alopecia

strings.zh: 評估方式 — 頭皮分 4 區
strings.en: Method — the scalp in four regions
SALT = (vertex % × 0.40) + (occiput % × 0.24) + (left side % × 0.18) + (right side % × 0.18)
Vertex (40%): from the hairline to the crown
Occiput (24%): the back of the head
Left side (18%): above the left ear to the temple
Right side (18%): above the right ear to the temple

strings.zh: 每區估算「該區內禿髮面積百分比」(0-100%)，建議以 5% 為單位
strings.en: For each region estimate the percentage of that region that is bald (0-100%), in steps of about 5%

strings.zh: 實作建議：對著鏡子或手機拍頭頂、後頸、兩側照片、印 / 描繪頭皮輪廓並圈出禿髮區域、用方格紙估算面積比例。家屬協助評估更精準。
strings.en: In practice: photograph the crown, nape and both sides in a mirror or with a phone, print or sketch the scalp outline, circle the bald areas and estimate the proportion on squared paper. A family member helping makes it more accurate.

strings.zh: 病灶內類固醇注射(Triamcinolone 5-10 mg/mL)± 外用 Minoxidil 5%
strings.en: Intralesional triamcinolone 5-10 mg/mL ± topical minoxidil 5%

strings.zh: + DPCP 外用免疫療法、Methotrexate、低劑量口服 Minoxidil 輔助
strings.en: + topical immunotherapy with DPCP, methotrexate, or low-dose oral minoxidil as an adjunct

strings.zh: Baricitinib（成人）或 Ritlecitinib(≥ 12 歲）—Rudnicka 2024 EU 共識首選
strings.en: Baricitinib (adults) or ritlecitinib (age ≥ 12) — first choice in the Rudnicka 2024 EU consensus

strings.zh: 特殊型別:Alopecia totalis（全頭禿）= SALT 100%;Alopecia universalis（全身禿）= SALT 100% + 全身體毛
strings.en: Special forms: alopecia totalis (whole scalp) = SALT 100%; alopecia universalis (whole body) = SALT 100% plus all body hair
SALT-30 / 50 / 75 / 90: the percentage fall in SALT after treatment

strings.zh: BRAVE-AA(Baricitinib)4 mg 36 週 SALT ≤ 20 達成 38.8%(vs 安慰劑 6.2%)
strings.en: BRAVE-AA (baricitinib) 4 mg: 38.8% reached SALT ≤ 20 at 36 weeks, against 6.2% on placebo

strings.zh: ALLEGRO(Ritlecitinib)50 mg 24 週 SALT ≤ 20 達成 23%(vs 2%)
strings.en: ALLEGRO (ritlecitinib) 50 mg: 23% reached SALT ≤ 20 at 24 weeks, against 2%

strings.zh: SALT ≥ 50 為 JAK 抑制劑的核准適應症 — 但 EMA 2023 警示 ≥ 65 歲、CV 高風險、惡性腫瘤、VTE 高風險者應僅在無替代時使用
strings.en: SALT ≥ 50 is the approved indication for a JAK inhibitor — but the EMA warned in 2023 that people aged 65+, or at high cardiovascular, malignancy or VTE risk, should receive one only where no alternative exists

strings.zh: 用藥前必須篩檢：結核、B/C 肝、HIV、CBC、肝腎、血脂、CPK、惡性腫瘤史
strings.en: Screen before starting: tuberculosis, hepatitis B and C, HIV, full blood count, liver and renal function, lipids, CPK, and any history of malignancy

strings.zh: 家族史 / 兒童早發 / 異膚共病者預後較差
strings.en: A family history, childhood onset or coexisting atopic dermatitis all carry a poorer prognosis

strings.zh: 追蹤頻率：治療開始後 12 週、24 週、36 週評估反應
strings.en: Follow-up: assess response at 12, 24 and 36 weeks after starting

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 估算誤差大（尤其重度 30-70% 區間）;(2) 不評估眉毛、睫毛、體毛（可改用 ALLEGRO 評估的 EBA / ELA scale);(3) 主觀性高、觀察者間差異；(4) AAS(Alopecia Areata Scale, King 2022)是更新的替代、涵蓋眉毛 / 睫毛。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) estimation error is large, especially in the 30-70% range; (2) it does not assess eyebrows, eyelashes or body hair (the EBA / ELA scales used in ALLEGRO cover those); (3) it is highly subjective, with wide inter-observer variation; (4) the AAS (Alopecia Areata Scale, King 2022) is a newer alternative that includes brows and lashes.
Open the SALT calculator →
Score 0-42

strings.zh: 慢性自發性蕁麻疹(CSU)每天活動度追蹤、必須連續 7 天記錄
strings.en: Daily activity tracking in chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU); it must be recorded on seven consecutive days

strings.zh: 判定 Omalizumab 健保 PASS 評估適應症
strings.en: Establishing the indication for omalizumab under the NHI PASS assessment

strings.zh: 不適用：急性蕁麻疹(< 6 週）、誘發性蕁麻疹（改用 trigger threshold test)、血管性水腫
strings.en: Not for: acute urticaria (< 6 weeks), inducible urticaria (use a trigger threshold test), or angioedema

strings.zh: 評估方式 — 連續 7 天日記
strings.en: Method — a diary over seven consecutive days

strings.zh: UAS7 = Σ（每天 風團數 + 癢感）從 Day 1 到 Day 7
strings.en: UAS7 = Σ (wheal count + itch) from day 1 to day 7
Item
Daily score
Wheals
0 = none / 1 = 1-10 / 2 = 10-50 / 3 = > 50 or large confluent areas
Itch

strings.zh: 0 = 無 / 1 = 輕（在意但不困擾） / 2 = 中（干擾日常但可入眠） / 3 = 重（干擾日常且失眠）
strings.en: 0 = none / 1 = mild (noticeable but not troublesome) / 2 = moderate (interferes with the day but sleep is possible) / 3 = severe (interferes with the day and disturbs sleep)

strings.zh: 每天最多 6 分（風團 0-3 + 癢感 0-3),7 天累積最高 42 分。建議搭配 EAACI 蕁麻疹日記 App（免費）。
strings.en: Up to 6 points a day (wheals 0-3 + itch 0-3), so at most 42 over seven days. The free EAACI urticaria diary app pairs well with it.
Activity
Complete control

strings.zh: 維持治療目標已達成、定期回診評估減量
strings.en: The maintenance target is met; review periodically with a view to stepping down
Well controlled

strings.zh: 持續抗組織胺，4-6 個月後考慮減量
strings.en: Continue the antihistamine and consider stepping down after 4-6 months

strings.zh: 抗組織胺加量至 4 倍標準劑量(2022 EAACI)
strings.en: Increase the antihistamine to four times the standard dose (2022 EAACI)

strings.zh: + Omalizumab 300 mg q4w（健保 PASS 申請）
strings.en: + omalizumab 300 mg q4w (NHI PASS application)

strings.zh: + Omalizumab（可加量至 600 mg q2w)± Cyclosporine(off-label)
strings.en: + omalizumab (escalable to 600 mg q2w) ± ciclosporin (off-label)

strings.zh: 治療目標 UAS7 ≤ 6（良好控制）,理想 UAS7 = 0
strings.en: The treatment target is UAS7 ≤ 6 (well controlled); UAS7 = 0 is the ideal

strings.zh: UAS7 與 UCT(Urticaria Control Test, 4 題）互補，UCT 易記但 UAS7 更精確
strings.en: UAS7 and the UCT (Urticaria Control Test, 4 items) complement each other: the UCT is easier to remember, UAS7 is more precise

strings.zh: 30% CSU 病人對 Omalizumab 反應不足（尤其低 IgE / 高抗 TPO IgG 的 Type IIb 自體免疫型）
strings.en: Around 30% of CSU patients respond inadequately to omalizumab, particularly the type IIb autoimmune group with low IgE and high anti-TPO IgG

strings.zh: 新藥前景：Remibrutinib(BTK)、Dupilumab(2024 FDA 核准）為 omalizumab 失敗替代
strings.en: On the horizon: remibrutinib (BTK) and dupilumab (FDA-approved 2024) as alternatives after omalizumab failure

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 需連續 7 天記錄、病人配合度差；(2) 不涵蓋血管性水腫（改用 AAS / AAS7);(3) 不適用誘發性蕁麻疹；(4) 自評有低估或高估傾向；(5) UAS7 = 0 但仍痛苦 → 評估焦慮共病(7-29% CSU 合併憂鬱焦慮）。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) it needs seven consecutive days of recording, and adherence is often poor; (2) it does not cover angioedema (use AAS / AAS7); (3) it does not apply to inducible urticaria; (4) self-rating tends to under- or over-state; (5) UAS7 = 0 with continuing distress → assess for anxiety, which coexists with depression or anxiety in 7-29% of CSU.
Open the UAS7 calculator →
Score 0-44
Acne vulgaris

strings.zh: 所有痤瘡嚴重度評估（青少年、成人皆可）
strings.en: Severity assessment for any acne, in adolescents and adults alike

strings.zh: 判定口服 Isotretinoin（羅可坦）健保適應症
strings.en: Establishing the NHI indication for oral isotretinoin
Tracking response to treatment

strings.zh: GAGS = Σ（部位最嚴重病灶分級 × 部位權重）
strings.en: GAGS = Σ (grade of the most severe lesion at a site × the site's weight)
Site
Weight
Forehead
Right cheek
Left cheek
Nose
Chin
Chest / upper back

strings.zh: 每部位的「最嚴重病灶」分級：
strings.en: Grade the most severe lesion at each site:
0 = no lesions
1 = ≥1 comedone
2 = ≥1 papule
3 = ≥1 pustule
4 = ≥1 nodule or cyst
Treatment strategy it points to (AAD 2024)

strings.zh: 外用 BPO + Adapalene 0.1% 或 Tretinoin(2024 強建議）
strings.en: Topical benzoyl peroxide + adapalene 0.1% or tretinoin (strongly recommended in 2024)

strings.zh: + 口服 Doxycycline 100 mg BID × 8-12 週、Spironolactone（女性）、Clascoterone
strings.en: + oral doxycycline 100 mg BID for 8-12 weeks, spironolactone (in women), clascoterone

strings.zh: 口服 Isotretinoin（健保條件：重度發炎 / 反覆失敗 / 疤痕風險）
strings.en: Oral isotretinoin (NHI criteria: severe inflammation, repeated failure, or scarring risk)

strings.zh: Isotretinoin + 病灶內類固醇 + 早期介入避免疤痕
strings.en: Isotretinoin + intralesional corticosteroid, intervening early to avoid scarring

strings.zh: GAGS 不評估痘疤、紅印、心理影響 — 需配合 ECCA（痘疤）、DLQI（心理）
strings.en: GAGS does not assess scarring, post-inflammatory marks or psychological impact — pair it with ECCA (scarring) and DLQI (psychological)

strings.zh: 女性 + 月經前惡化 + 下顎 / 頸部 + 多毛症 + 月經不規則 → 考慮 PCOS 內分泌評估
strings.en: A woman with premenstrual flares, jawline or neck distribution, hirsutism and irregular periods → consider endocrine assessment for PCOS

strings.zh: 30 歲以上女性新發痤瘡 → 排除多囊卵巢、雄激素瘤、月經不調
strings.en: New-onset acne in a woman over 30 → exclude polycystic ovary syndrome, an androgen-secreting tumour and menstrual irregularity

strings.zh: 口服 A 酸前必做：肝功能、血脂、孕婦驗孕（育齡女性嚴格避孕）
strings.en: Before oral isotretinoin: liver function, lipids, and a pregnancy test — with strict contraception for anyone of childbearing potential

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 不評估痘疤(ECCA、Goodman scar scale 替代）;(2) 不評估紅印 PIE / 黑印 PIH（亞洲人重要）;(3) 評估「最嚴重病灶」可能高估（只要 1 顆結節 = 4 分）;(4) IGA(Investigator's Global Assessment, 0-4 整體印象）更簡便；(5) IAA-GES(Investigator's Acne Assessment, 6 grade)為近年 FDA 試驗常用。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) it does not assess scarring (use ECCA or the Goodman scar scale); (2) it does not assess post-inflammatory erythema or hyperpigmentation, which matter in Asian skin; (3) grading by the most severe lesion can overstate — a single nodule scores 4; (4) the IGA (Investigator's Global Assessment, 0-4) is simpler; (5) the six-grade IAA-GES has become common in recent FDA trials.
Open the GAGS calculator →
Score 0-48
Melasma

strings.zh: 肝斑(melasma)嚴重度與治療反應追蹤
strings.en: Severity and treatment response in melasma

strings.zh: 不適用：單純曬斑(solar lentigo)、太田 / 顴骨母斑（改用 OMRA / ABRA)、PIH（改用 PGA)
strings.en: Not for: solar lentigines, naevus of Ota or Hori's naevus (use OMRA / ABRA), or post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (use PGA)

strings.zh: 近年常用簡化版 mMASI(modified MASI)，省去同質性項目
strings.en: The simplified mMASI (modified MASI), which drops the homogeneity item, is now widely used

strings.zh:
MASI = 0.3×Af×(Df+Hf) + 0.3×Ar×(Dr+Hr) + 0.3×Al×(Dl+Hl) + 0.1×Ac×(Dc+Hc)
f = 前額 / r = 右臉頰 / l = 左臉頰 / c = 下巴
strings.en:
MASI = 0.3×Af×(Df+Hf) + 0.3×Ar×(Dr+Hr) + 0.3×Al×(Dl+Hl) + 0.1×Ac×(Dc+Hc)
f = forehead / r = right cheek / l = left cheek / c = chin

strings.zh: 4 個臉部區域權重：前額 ×0.3、右臉頰 ×0.3、左臉頰 ×0.3、下巴 ×0.1
strings.en: Four facial regions, weighted: forehead ×0.3, right cheek ×0.3, left cheek ×0.3, chin ×0.1
Area A (0-6): the same grades as PASI (0 = 0%, 1 = <10%, 2 = 10-29% … 6 = 90-100%)

strings.zh: 深淺 D(0-4):0 = 無 / 1 = 略深 / 2 = 中 / 3 = 深 / 4 = 極深
strings.en: Darkness D (0-4): 0 = absent / 1 = slight / 2 = moderate / 3 = marked / 4 = severe

strings.zh: 同質性 H(0-4)：色塊內顏色一致性，0 = 無 / 4 = 完全均勻
strings.en: Homogeneity H (0-4): how uniform the colour is within the patch, 0 = minimal / 4 = completely uniform

strings.zh: 嚴格防曬(SPF 50+ 含氧化鐵）+ Azelaic acid 15-20% / Niacinamide
strings.en: Strict photoprotection (SPF 50+ containing iron oxide) + azelaic acid 15-20% / niacinamide

strings.zh: + Tri-Luma（對苯二酚 4% + Tretinoin + Fluocinolone)8-12 週 → 維持
strings.en: + triple combination cream (hydroquinone 4% + tretinoin + fluocinolone) for 8-12 weeks, then maintenance

strings.zh: + 口服 Tranexamic acid 250 mg BID-TID + 低能量 Q-switched 1064 nm toning;Cysteamine 5%
strings.en: + oral tranexamic acid 250 mg BID-TID + low-fluence 1064 nm Q-switched toning; cysteamine 5%
MASI-50: a fall of ≥ 50% after treatment (clinically meaningful)

strings.zh: 典型療程需 8-16 週才看到顯著變化
strings.en: A typical course takes 8-16 weeks before the change is obvious

strings.zh: 「肝斑無法根治、只能控制」— 停藥就反黑、需終身防曬
strings.en: Melasma cannot be cured, only controlled — it darkens again once treatment stops, and photoprotection is lifelong

strings.zh: 口服 TXA 禁忌：深部靜脈栓塞史、孕婦、口服避孕藥（高血栓風險）
strings.en: Oral tranexamic acid is contraindicated with a history of deep vein thrombosis, in pregnancy, and with the combined oral contraceptive pill (thrombotic risk)

strings.zh: 傳統強脈衝雷射會誘發肝斑反黑 — 需用低能量 toning（蜂巢皮秒）
strings.en: Conventional high-fluence lasers can drive melasma darker — use low-fluence toning (picosecond) instead

strings.zh: 女性懷孕 / 哺乳期建議：防曬 + Azelaic acid(L3 安全），避開 hydroquinone、TXA、Tri-Luma
strings.en: In pregnancy and breastfeeding: photoprotection plus azelaic acid (L3, safe); avoid hydroquinone, tranexamic acid and the triple combination cream

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 主觀評分、觀察者間差異大；(2) 同質性(H)在亞洲人深褐色肝斑難判讀；(3) 不評估「真皮型 vs 表皮型」（可用 Wood lamp 輔助）;(4) 治療前後攝影應固定光源、距離、角度避免誤差；(5) mMASI（去除 H)觀察者間信度更高。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) subjective, with wide inter-observer variation; (2) homogeneity (H) is hard to judge in the deep brown melasma common in Asian skin; (3) it does not distinguish dermal from epidermal melasma (a Wood's lamp helps); (4) before-and-after photographs must use fixed lighting, distance and angle; (5) mMASI, without H, has better inter-observer reliability.
Open the MASI calculator →
Hidradenitis suppurativa (HS)

strings.zh: 化膿性汗腺炎(HS / 反常性痤瘡）嚴重度分期
strings.en: Severity staging for hidradenitis suppurativa (HS, acne inversa)

strings.zh: 判定 Adalimumab（復邁）健保條件給付適應症(Hurley II/III)
strings.en: Establishing the indication for conditionally NHI-funded adalimumab (Hurley II/III)

strings.zh: 不適用：單純癤、急性毛囊炎、藏毛囊腫
strings.en: Not for: a simple furuncle, acute folliculitis, or pilonidal sinus

strings.zh: 評估方式 — 三期分級
strings.en: Method — three stages
Stage
Definition
Stage I, mild

strings.zh: 單一或多個獨立膿瘍 / 結節、無通道、無疤痕
strings.en: One or more isolated abscesses or nodules, with no sinus tracts and no scarring
Stage II, moderate

strings.zh: 反覆膿瘍、形成通道(sinus tract)與疤痕，但病灶獨立分隔
strings.en: Recurrent abscesses with sinus tracts and scarring, but the lesions remain separated
Stage III, severe

strings.zh: 多個互相連結的通道與膿瘍，大面積疤痕與纖維化
strings.en: Multiple interconnected tracts and abscesses, with extensive scarring and fibrosis

strings.zh: 分數解讀 + 對應治療
strings.en: How to read it, and the treatment it points to

strings.zh: 外用 Clindamycin 1% + 短期口服 Doxycycline 50-100 mg BID × 12 週 + 生活調整（減重、戒菸、寬鬆衣物）+ 切開引流
strings.en: Topical clindamycin 1% + a short course of oral doxycycline 50-100 mg BID for 12 weeks + lifestyle measures (weight loss, stopping smoking, loose clothing) + incision and drainage

strings.zh: 長期口服 Clindamycin 300 mg + Rifampicin 600 mg 各 BID × 10-12 週；Acitretin / 抗雄激素；Adalimumab（健保條件給付）；局部 deroofing 手術
strings.en: Long-course oral clindamycin 300 mg + rifampicin 600 mg, both BID for 10-12 weeks; acitretin or antiandrogens; adalimumab (conditionally NHI-funded); local deroofing

strings.zh: Adalimumab + 廣泛切除 + 皮瓣重建；Secukinumab(2023 FDA 新核准 IL-17 抑制劑）為新選項
strings.en: Adalimumab + wide excision + flap reconstruction; secukinumab, the IL-17 inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2023, is a newer option
Supporting scales

strings.zh: Sartorius score：更精細的計數系統（病灶數 × 解剖位置 × 距離）
strings.en: Sartorius score: a finer counting system (lesion count × anatomical site × distance)

strings.zh: IHS4(International HS Severity Score System)：結節數 + 膿瘍數 ×2 + 通道 ×4（用於試驗反應追蹤）
strings.en: IHS4 (International HS Severity Score System): nodules + abscesses ×2 + tracts ×4, used to track trial response

strings.zh: HiSCR(HS Clinical Response)：膿瘍 + 結節數降幅 ≥ 50% 且通道未增加 = 反應(Adalimumab 試驗指標）
strings.en: HiSCR (HS Clinical Response): a fall of ≥ 50% in abscess and nodule count with no increase in tracts counts as a response — the adalimumab trial endpoint

strings.zh: HS 平均延遲診斷 7-10 年（常被誤認為癤瘡 / 毛囊炎），早期介入可避免不可逆通道形成
strings.en: HS is diagnosed an average of 7-10 years late, often mistaken for boils or folliculitis; intervening early avoids irreversible tract formation

strings.zh: Hurley II/III + DLQI ≥ 10 + 兩線傳統治療失敗 = Adalimumab 健保申請門檻
strings.en: Hurley II/III + DLQI ≥ 10 + failure of two conventional therapies = the NHI threshold for adalimumab

strings.zh: 合併症高：克隆氏症、PsA、PsC、代謝症候群、憂鬱 — 應系統性篩檢
strings.en: Comorbidity is common — Crohn's disease, psoriatic arthritis, pyoderma gangrenosum, metabolic syndrome, depression — and should be screened for systematically

strings.zh: 戒菸 + 減重 + 規律治療為長期成效關鍵
strings.en: Stopping smoking, losing weight and treating consistently are what determine the long-term result

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 三期分級過於粗糙,Stage II 涵蓋範圍極廣；(2) 不評估「目前活動度」（可能 Stage III 但無新發病灶）;(3) 不適合用於追蹤治療反應（改用 IHS4 或 HiSCR);(4) 主觀、通道 vs 疤痕鑑別需經驗。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) three stages are too coarse, and stage II covers a very wide range; (2) it says nothing about current activity — someone can be stage III with no new lesions; (3) it is unsuited to tracking response (use IHS4 or HiSCR); (4) it is subjective, and telling a tract from a scar takes experience.

strings.zh: 啟動 Hurley 分期工具 →
strings.en: Open the Hurley staging tool →
— clinical grading of androgenetic alopecia
Men I-VII / women I-III
Androgenetic alopecia (AGA)
Male pattern hair loss → use Norwood-Hamilton (I-VII)

strings.zh: 女性雄性禿 → 用 Ludwig(I-III)或 Olsen（中央型）
strings.en: Female pattern hair loss → use Ludwig (I-III), or Olsen for the central pattern

strings.zh: 不適用：圓禿（用 SALT)、瀰漫性休止期落髮（改用拔毛測試 + Trichoscopy)、瘢痕性禿髮
strings.en: Not for: alopecia areata (use SALT), diffuse telogen effluvium (use a pull test with trichoscopy), or cicatricial alopecia
Norwood-Hamilton grades (men)
Grade
Features

strings.zh: 無明顯禿髮 / 微微髮際後退
strings.en: No obvious loss, or minimal hairline recession

strings.zh: 輕度 M 型髮際後退
strings.en: Mild M-shaped hairline recession

strings.zh: 明顯 M 型禿、可能合併頭頂稀疏
strings.en: Marked M-shaped recession, possibly with crown thinning

strings.zh: 頭頂明顯稀疏 + III 級髮際
strings.en: Obvious crown thinning plus a grade III hairline

strings.zh: 髮際線顯著後退 + 頭頂禿髮 + 中間有髮帶
strings.en: Marked hairline recession plus crown baldness, with a bridge of hair between them

strings.zh: 大面積頭頂禿、中間髮帶減少、僅後方環狀剩餘
strings.en: Extensive crown baldness, the bridge thinning, only a rim remaining behind

strings.zh: 頭頂與前方禿髮融合、中間髮帶消失
strings.en: Crown and frontal baldness merge and the bridge disappears

strings.zh: 僅後枕部 / 兩側馬蹄形剩餘（最嚴重）
strings.en: Only the horseshoe of occipital and lateral hair remains — the most advanced
Ludwig grades (women)

strings.zh: 頭頂中央輕度稀疏、前髮際保留
strings.en: Mild central thinning with the frontal hairline preserved

strings.zh: 頭頂中央明顯稀疏、前髮際保留
strings.en: Marked central thinning with the frontal hairline preserved

strings.zh: 頭頂中央近乎全禿、前髮際仍可保留
strings.en: Near-complete central loss, the frontal hairline still preserved

strings.zh: 女性特徵：「聖誕樹徵象(Christmas tree pattern)」— 頭頂中央分線變寬如三角形、但前髮際線保留（與男性不同）。
strings.en: The female pattern: the Christmas tree sign — the central parting widens into a triangle while the frontal hairline is preserved, unlike the male pattern.
Men
Women

Mild
(I-II)

strings.zh:
外用 Minoxidil 5% bid
± Finasteride 1 mg/day
strings.en:
Topical minoxidil 5% BID
± finasteride 1 mg/day

外用 Minoxidil 2-5%
± LDOM 0.5-1.25 mg/day(Olsen 2025)

(III-IV)

Finasteride + Minoxidil 雙標準
± PRP 注射
規劃植髮諮詢
strings.en:
Finasteride + minoxidil, the standard pair
± PRP injections
discuss transplantation

Minoxidil + Spironolactone 主軸
+ LDOM 1.25-2.5 mg
± PRP
strings.en:
Minoxidil + spironolactone as the mainstay
+ LDOM 1.25-2.5 mg
± PRP

Severe
(V-VII)

strings.zh: 植髮(FUE / FUT) + 持續藥物維持
strings.en: Transplantation (FUE / FUT) with continued medical maintenance
Transplantation with continued medical therapy

strings.zh: 「Minoxidil 不能停」 — 停藥後 3-6 個月失去療效，2 年內恢復原本進度
strings.en: Minoxidil cannot be stopped — the benefit is lost 3-6 months after stopping, and within two years the loss returns to where it would have been

strings.zh: Finasteride 副作用：性慾下降 / 勃起困難 ~1-2%，停藥可逆；PFS(post-finasteride syndrome)極罕見
strings.en: Finasteride side effects: reduced libido or erectile difficulty in about 1-2%, reversible on stopping; post-finasteride syndrome is very rare

strings.zh: 女性禁用 Finasteride / Dutasteride（致畸風險、即使懷孕前）
strings.en: Finasteride and dutasteride are contraindicated in women because of teratogenicity, even before a pregnancy

strings.zh: 植髮前先吃 Finasteride 6 個月穩定、避免 2-5 年後旁邊未植區繼續禿掉
strings.en: Take finasteride for six months before transplantation to stabilise the loss, so the untransplanted areas do not continue receding two to five years later

strings.zh: 限制：(1) Norwood 早期變化(I-II)觀察者間差異大；(2) Ludwig 不適合前髮際後退型女性禿（改用 Olsen 中央型分級）;(3) 不評估毛幹直徑變細(Trichoscopy 看毛幹細化更靈敏）;(4) 部分女性禿合併雄激素過多 → 需檢驗 testosterone、DHEAS、PCOS 篩檢。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) inter-observer variation is wide for early Norwood grades (I-II); (2) Ludwig does not suit women with frontal recession (use Olsen's central pattern grading); (3) it does not measure shaft miniaturisation, which trichoscopy detects far earlier; (4) some female pattern loss coexists with androgen excess — check testosterone, DHEAS and screen for PCOS.

All of dermatology and aesthetics

strings.zh: 所有雷射 / 化學換膚 / 醫美術前評估（預測 PIH 反黑風險）
strings.en: Pre-procedure assessment for any laser, chemical peel or aesthetic treatment, predicting the risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
Stratifying photoprotection needs and skin cancer risk

strings.zh: 不直接代表絕對膚色 — 反映「曬太陽後皮膚反應」（光照敏感度）
strings.en: It does not simply mean skin colour — it reflects how skin reacts to sun exposure, i.e. photosensitivity
Method — two dimensions

strings.zh: 結合「未曬太陽時的基礎膚色」+「初夏中午陽光下 30-60 分鐘後的反應」綜合評估。
strings.en: Combines your unexposed baseline skin colour with how it reacts after 30-60 minutes of early-summer midday sun.

strings.zh: 1064 nm Nd:YAG 較安全；532/694/755 nm 易引起色素沉著
strings.en: 1064 nm Nd:YAG is safer; 532, 694 and 755 nm readily cause pigmentation

strings.zh: 低但易延誤診斷(SCC 預後較差）
strings.en: Low, but easily diagnosed late — SCC carries a worse prognosis here

strings.zh: 多數台灣人為 III-IV 型 — 雷射 / 化學換膚後反黑風險高、需嚴格防曬 4 週以上
strings.en: Most Taiwanese are type III-IV — the risk of darkening after a laser or peel is high, so photoprotect strictly for at least four weeks

strings.zh: I-II 型應每年接受全身皮膚檢查（尤其 50 歲以上）
strings.en: Types I-II should have a full skin examination annually, particularly over the age of 50

strings.zh: V-VI 型雖皮膚癌風險低、但 SCC 多發生於足底 / 指甲下、且容易被忽略（色素掩蓋）
strings.en: Skin cancer risk is low in types V-VI, but SCC often arises on the sole or under a nail and is easily missed, since pigment obscures it

strings.zh: 含氧化鐵防曬對 III-VI 型亞洲人特別重要（可阻擋可見光誘發肝斑）
strings.en: Sunscreen containing iron oxide matters particularly for Asian types III-VI, because it blocks the visible light that drives melasma

strings.zh: 限制：(1) 主觀回答，有自我認知偏差；(2) 同一人冬夏不同；(3) 不直接反映黑色素含量（可用客觀儀器 Mexameter / spectrophotometer);(4) 國際分類無法完全代表亞洲族群、可參考更細緻的 ITA(Individual Typology Angle);(5) 膚色分型不等於皮膚癌絕對風險（基因 / 累積 UV 暴露 / 家族史更重要）。
strings.en: Limitations: (1) it relies on self-report, with its own biases; (2) the same person answers differently in winter and summer; (3) it does not directly measure melanin — a Mexameter or spectrophotometer does; (4) the international classification does not fit Asian populations well, and the ITA (Individual Typology Angle) is finer; (5) phototype is not an absolute cancer risk — genetics, cumulative UV exposure and family history matter more.

strings.en: Open the Fitzpatrick typing tool →

strings.zh: 使用建議 — 量表只是工具、不是診斷
strings.en: How to use these — a scale is a tool, not a diagnosis

strings.zh: 量表是「客觀化主觀」的工具，讓您與醫師對話時能精確描述病情變化、而非單純「比上次好一點」這種模糊感受。
strings.en: A scale makes something subjective measurable, so you can describe how your disease has changed precisely rather than as a vague "a bit better than last time".

strings.zh: 追蹤更重要：第一次計算分數沒意義、連續 4-12 週對照才看得到趨勢。建議拍照 + 寫日記。
strings.en: The trend matters more than the number: a single score means little, and only 4-12 weeks of consecutive readings show a direction. Photographs and a diary help.

strings.zh: 多個量表合用：疾病活動度(SCORAD / PASI)+ 生活品質(DLQI)+ 心理共病(PHQ-9 / GAD-7)三方視角才完整。
strings.en: Use more than one: disease activity (SCORAD / PASI) + quality of life (DLQI) + psychological comorbidity (PHQ-9 / GAD-7) together give the full picture.

strings.zh: 健保生物製劑申請需專科醫師親自評估與簽署、自評分數僅供參考、不能直接申請。
strings.en: An NHI biologic application requires a specialist's own assessment and signature; a self-rated score is for reference only and cannot be submitted on its own.

strings.zh: 本網站所有量表均無業配、無贊助、無聯盟連結，引用的學會共識可點擊 PubMed 查證。發現錯誤請寫信告知。
strings.en: None of the scales on this site carries advertising, sponsorship or affiliate links, and every society consensus cited can be checked on PubMed. If you spot an error, please email us.

strings.zh: 延伸閱讀： 想看完整衛教文章請至 衛教文章索引；查詢專業詞彙白話解釋至 醫學詞彙白話字典。實際病情評估、處方、療程、請就近至皮膚科專科醫師門診面對面看診。
strings.en: Further reading: for the full patient guides see the article index; for plain-English explanations of the terminology see the dermatology glossary. For assessment, prescribing and treatment itself, please see a dermatologist in person.
